description: Baby massage classes led by an experienced Paediatric/Neonatal Intensive Care Nurse (10+ years), open to all babies from birth to 12 months, including those with special needs, complex needs, or life-limiting conditions. description: Do Your Dance Tots: Saturdays, 10:15-11am (ages 2-4), Newtownpark Pastoral Centre, Blackrock.
